title: hieracium germanicum subsp. fallacinum
intro: Hieracium germanicum subsp. fallacinum, commonly known as Fall Cuckoo's-beans or False Hawk's Beard, is a subspecies of the Hieracium germanicum plant, belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium germanicum subsp. fallacinum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
